verses.1: And in Benyamin, the second Ashbel was born, and after him, the third one was born.
verses.2: The fourth night, and the fifth day of healing.
verses.3: And they became sons of Balad and Gera, and their father was Judah.
verses.5: And they were called Ge’ra, Shpufan, and Chur’am.
verses.6: And these sons of Ehad are the leaders of the fathers who lived in the wilderness. They were sent to Manahath.
verses.7: And Naaman and his brother, along with Gerah, became his followers. He also gave birth to Uzzah and Ahijud.
verses.8: And the locusts are born in the field of Moab. They are sent forth by Him. They know what it means to be a locust.
verses.9: And from that month, he became father to Yovav, Tzivia, Misha, and Malkham.
verses.10: And they are also their deceitfulness, their cunningness, and their deceitfulness. These are the children of their fathers.
verses.11: And from them will be born Abituv and Elpahl.
verses.12: And the sons of Elphael built over and from She’am and Shammed. They also built Ono and Lod, along with their daughters.
verses.13: And in their anger and hatred, those leaders of the Abohim drove out the inhabitants of Gath.
verses.14: And his brothers were Shashak and Yirimot.
verses.16: And Micahel, Ishpa, and Yoah were sons of Breea.
verses.17: And Zevdia, Meshulam, Hizki, and Chaver.
verses.18: And Yishmarya, Zelia, and Yovav will be the sons of Elpaal.
verses.21: And Adaya, and Baraia, and they shall protect the children of Shimei.
verses.22: And it shall be called Eliel.
verses.25: And He will save them, along with the children of Shechem.
verses.27: And Yairiyah, Eliah, and Zikri, sons of Joram.
verses.28: These are the heads of their mothers; these will sit in Jerusalem.
verses.29: And in Gibeon, Abi Gibeon and his wife Maachah will live.
verses.30: And his sons were Abdon, Zohar, Kish, and Na’dor.
verses.31: And Gidor and his brothers, and Zachar.
verses.32: And those who were born in Shema’ah and their families will sit together in Jerusalem with their relatives.
verses.33: And Ner gave birth to Kish; Kish, in turn, gave birth to Shaul. Shaul, on his part, gave birth to Yehonatan. Yehonatan, then, gave birth to Malchij Shua, and also Abinadab and Esbail.
verses.34: And Benjamin, son of Judah, quarreled with his father. He also quarreled with his father, and as a result, he had a son named Micah.
verses.35: And the sons of Micah, Pithon, Mello, and Tahar’e.
verses.36: And the child holds onto Yehoshadah. Yehoshadah, in turn, holds onto Almet and Azmavot. And Zimri and Zimri hold onto Motsa.
verses.37: And the offspring of Holid found Bena’ah. They became Elashah, and they became Atsel.
verses.38: And there were six sons, and their names were Azrikam, Bokhru, Yishmael, Sh'arya, Ovedya, and Hanan. All of these were sons of Atsal.
verses.39: And Eshek’s sons were his brothers. But in their descendants, the second and third generations were born.
verses.40: And the sons of Ulam were men who lived in caves. They had many children and grandchildren. In total, they had one hundred and fifty children. All of these were the descendants of Biniam.
